_comments.note: Telegram credentials and the database connection are NOT in this file - they live in environment variables (TELEGRAM_API_ID, TELEGRAM_API_HASH, TELEGRAM_SESSION, TELEGRAM_CHANNEL, DATABASE_URL). This file has no secrets, so it's safe to commit to GitHub.
_comments.starting_balance: Your paper account's starting balance in dollars.
_comments.position_size_pct: % of CURRENT balance risked on each new trade.
_comments.max_exposure_pct: Once this % of balance is tied up in open positions, new alerts are skipped.
_comments.fee_pct: Simulated round-trip fee + slippage, applied to every trade.
_comments.timeout_minutes: Force-close a position after this many minutes if neither target nor stop hit.
_comments.max_wait_for_price_minutes: If DexScreener never returns ANY price data within this many minutes of opening (common for a token that hasn't been indexed yet, or an instant rug with no real pool), the position is VOIDED - no fake loss recorded, bet is untouched, logged separately from real trades.
_comments.fixed_target_multiple: Take-profit target for the 'Fixed target' portfolio.
_comments.scaled_stop_loss_pct: Stop-loss for the 'Scaled + trailing' portfolio if 2x is never reached.
_comments.scaled_trailing_pct: Once 2x is hit, remaining position exits if price falls this % off peak.
_comments.dip_entry_enabled: If true, don't buy immediately on the alert - watch the token first and only buy on a qualifying pullback (see dip_buy_min_pct/dip_buy_max_pct/dip_min_bounce_pct). Set false to restore instant-buy-on-alert behavior.
_comments.dip_buy_min_pct: Minimum pullback (% down from the peak price seen since the alert) required before buying.
_comments.dip_buy_max_pct: Maximum pullback (%) still considered a healthy entry. Above this, we keep watching rather than buying (it might recover into the buy zone, or keep falling into the skip zone). Backed by real channel history: 30-60% dips still meaningfully beat the no-signal baseline (23%), so this is wider than a naive guess.
_comments.dip_skip_pct: If the pullback ever goes past this % down from peak, the token is abandoned entirely - no entry, in either portfolio. Real channel history shows the hit-rate edge mostly disappears past ~65-70% down, not 45% as originally guessed.
_comments.dip_min_bounce_pct: Minimum recovery off the LOCAL LOW (not off peak) required before buying, on top of being in the dip_buy range. Real history shows dip depth alone under-predicts outcomes; a stronger bounce off the low (20%+) correlates with a meaningfully higher hit rate (~40% vs ~30% for weak bounces), so this is a separate, additional condition.
_comments.dip_watch_max_minutes: Give up watching a token for a qualifying dip after this many minutes if it never triggers a buy or a skip (e.g. it just sits flat).
